n: Great Scott Gadgets YARD Stick One
t: A USB radio stick for studying sub-1 GHz signals from Python.
steps: Buy YARD Stick One from a reseller listed by Great Scott Gadgets, such as Adafruit or Hacker Warehouse.
Buy an SMA antenna for the band you want to study.
Install Python with pyusb and libusb on your computer.
Install RfCat and set up the USB permission rules.
Plug in the stick and open the interactive rfcat shell.
Set the frequency of your own sensor and watch packets arrive.
Stay in receive-only mode unless you hold an amateur radio license.
meta: Wild Open. From $99.95. A few stores.
